scope.imageEvidence: testdata/aws/ecs/task_runtime_bounds.json imageEvidence and RUNNING DescribeTasks observations
scope.transport: scripts/aws/aws_cli.py run; AWS CLI JSON output/error format; no automatic pagination; one SDK attempt
scope.requestInputJSON: Exact json.dumps serialization supplied to aws_cli.run, which serializes parameters with json.dumps before --cli-input-json. CLI-generated wire defaults/client tokens, if any, are not claimed as captured raw HTTP.
scope.network: Owned IPv4 VPC/subnet/security group with default outbound, no inbound rules, public-IP ENIs and IGW route. No NAT/load balancer/database.
scope.sharedRole: AWSServiceRoleForECS observed only; never modified or deleted.

notes.finding: With no cluster capacity-provider default, omitted launchType on bridge-compatible EC2 definition resolves to EC2, not FARGATE. desiredCount is required for default REPLICA. Explicit FARGATE/awsvpc requires network even at desiredCount=0. Initial Fargate service platformVersion is LATEST; observed deployment/tasks resolve 1.4.0. The shared ECS service-linked role is returned for Fargate, absent from this EC2-zero service.

idempotency.finding: Same token, same name and same request succeeds and preserves the service ARN/createdAt/deployment identity. Same name with a different token or omitted token rejects InvalidParameterException: Creation of service was not idempotent. This is not RunTask ConflictException.

Same token and name with changed tags succeeds, but retains original tags: tags are not mutated by replay. Same token with different serviceName creates a second service; this experiment does not establish a cluster-global CreateService token conflict rule.

Same Fargate service token with changed desiredCount or taskDefinition rejects InvalidParameterException, and following describes retain desiredCount=0 and original latest-qualified definition. Tokens longer than 36 rejected.

qualification.finding: Family-only create resolves latest active revision :2; update family:1 resolves full ARN :1 and creates a new PRIMARY deployment with previous deployment ACTIVE; full task definition ARN create succeeds. These are snapshots of one rolling deployment, not all deployment modes.

readsAndTags.finding: DescribeServices omits tags without include=TAGS and includes tags with it; mixed existing/missing names succeeds with service plus failures reason MISSING. TagResource and UntagResource observed, and list-tags-for-resource returns added tag. Invalid include rejected.

ListServices returns full ARNs, supports native FARGATE/EC2 and REPLICA/DAEMON filters and opaque pagination. Deleted DRAINING service disappears from listing while DescribeServices can still return it. No ordering guarantee inferred.

admissionErrors.note: All listed error rows are AWS CLI service-error exits 254, not invented codes. Missing cluster is ClusterNotFoundException across all five service APIs; missing update/delete service is ServiceNotFoundException. See exact inputs/error outputs for precedence and messages; finite probes are not a complete validator specification.

circuitBreaker.finding: Default circuit breaker is enable=false, rollback=false, resetOnHealthyTask=true, thresholdConfiguration={type:BOUNDED_PERCENT,value:50}. Zero-count COUNT=1/reset=false create and BOUNDED_PERCENT=1 or UNBOUNDED_PERCENT=100 updates accepted. COUNT=0, BOUNDED_PERCENT=101, and bogus type rejected InvalidParameterException. enable=false/rollback=true and disabled custom threshold accepted.

Threshold calculation, reset-on-health behavior, rollback and FAILED runtime transitions were not exercised. Documentation says bounded percentage ceil(value/100*latestDesiredCount), clamped 3..200; UNBOUNDED_PERCENT has no such clamp and COUNT uses value directly.

maximumPercent=100 is rejected while default availabilityZoneRebalancing=ENABLED. Updating rebalancing to DISABLED together with maximumPercent=100/minimumHealthyPercent=0 succeeds, used to constrain task overlap before scaling to two. Updating deploymentConfiguration returned a narrower circuit-breaker shape in some responses; do not infer erased fields from omission alone.

reconciliation.finding: UpdateService desiredCount is asynchronous: scale-one initially returns/listed zero tasks, then pending then running. Scale 1->2 initially retains one running, later two running and deployment COMPLETED. Scale 2->0 initially still has runningCount=2, later zero and all known tasks STOPPED.

Explicit StopTask on the sole RUNNING service task reports UserInitiated with requested reason; desiredCount remains one, original reaches STOPPED, and scheduler creates different RUNNING task without another update. Replacement task retains service group and deployment startedBy.

Service task group is service:<serviceName>; startedBy is ecs-svc/<deployment-id>, not caller ARN. ListTasks startedBy selects deployment tasks. No task IAM role or execution role was needed for this public image without logs/secrets. Task tags are empty under default propagateTags=NONE and enableECSManagedTags=false despite service tags.

Force-new-deployment at desiredCount=0 creates a different PRIMARY deployment with same task definition and keeps previous deployment ACTIVE; subsequent scale-one reached a RUNNING task owned by new deployment. Intermediate scheduler stopped a task started for previous deployment. This does not establish all rolling, circuit-breaker, rollback or controller semantics.

Counts are asynchronous sampled views: the initial revision transition included a PENDING task with desiredStatus=STOPPED alongside PENDING desiredStatus=RUNNING; later force-drain service runningCount=0 while task lastStatus remained RUNNING with desiredStatus STOPPED. Do not derive all counters solely from lastStatus or assume atomic snapshots across APIs.

deletion.finding: An ACTIVE desiredCount=0 service contributes to activeServicesCount and blocks DeleteCluster with ClusterContainsServicesException. Nonzero desiredCount DeleteService rejects InvalidParameterException without force, even before readiness.

force=true on a RUNNING desiredCount=1 service succeeds, returns DRAINING with desiredCount=0 but runningCount=1. Listing hides it, update rejects ServiceNotActiveException, and same-name recreate during draining rejects InvalidParameterException. DeleteCluster after all services deleted but a task still active rejects ClusterContainsTasksException.

Zero service delete initially DRAINING, repeated delete succeeds, update rejects ServiceNotActiveException; later zero services INACTIVE. Runtime service still DRAINING at final describe although every task STOPPED, counters zero, ENIs gone and cluster deletion then succeeded. Thus no observed final runtime-service INACTIVE timestamp is claimed.

definitions.note: All six owned definitions deregistered and accepted for deletion. All six remained DELETE_IN_PROGRESS on final describe; disappearance not claimed. Initial colliding prefix revision :1 belongs to EventBridge capture and was untouched.
